name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.common.ui.activities.BrowseActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin (CommsEase) common UI SDK opens this screen when the app shows a web page in its in-app browser. It provides a title bar and back navigation, and sends other kinds of links to an app that can open them.
disableEffect: Web pages that rely on the Yunxin in-app browser will not open.
